cfgEngineAi.message: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint with your key

cfgTarget.message: Target language code (e.g. zh-CN, en, ja).

cfgEndpoint.message: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Ollama, …).

cfgModel.message: Model name for the AI engine.

cfgProvider.message: AI provider id. Use **DualTran: Choose AI Provider** to pick from the built-in list and the 200+ providers in models.dev; the command fills in the matching endpoint and model.

cfgReasoning.message: How much reasoning effort to request. Unknown or unsupported levels are dropped automatically.

cfgReasoningLowest.message: Use the lowest level the selected model accepts (default)

cfgReasoningDefault.message: Send no reasoning parameter — let the provider decide

warnSelectText.message: DualTran: select the text to replace.

inputApiKeyPromptExisting.message: Stored in the OS keychain via VS Code SecretStorage. Leave empty to keep the current key.

errorNoApiKey.message: No API key set (DualTran: Set AI API Key).

pickProviderPlaceholder.message: Built-in first, then every provider models.dev knows
